description: Source code for handling dynamic images in the Google Breakpad crash reporting system on macOS, including functions for reading process memory, parsing Mach-O headers, and managing loaded images.

classes.name: MachO32
classes.description: Traits for 32-bit Mach-O files, defining header and load command types.

classes.name: MachO64
classes.description: Traits for 64-bit Mach-O files, defining header and load command types.

classes.name: DynamicImage
classes.description: Represents a loaded Mach-O image, with methods to calculate memory info and find sections.

classes.name: DynamicImages
classes.description: Manages a collection of dynamically loaded images in a target process, including reading image info and identifying the executable image.

methods.name: FindTextSection
methods.description: Template function to locate the __TEXT segment in a Mach-O image.

methods.name: CalculateMemoryAndVersionInfo
methods.description: Initializes vmaddr_, vmsize_, slide_, and version_ for a DynamicImage.

methods.name: GetFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the Mach-O header.

methods.name: GetDyldAllImageInfosPointer
methods.description: Retrieves the pointer to dyld's all image infos, using dyld info or symbol lookup.

methods.name: ReadImageInfo
methods.description: Template function to read loaded image info from a target process's memory.

methods.name: ReadImageInfoForTask
methods.description: Reads image info for the current task.

methods.name: GetExecutableImageIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of the executable image.

methods.name: DetermineTaskCPUType
methods.description: Determines the CPU type of a given task.
